content: The strongest near-term differentiators for nABrush are cross-platform parity (macOS and Windows), dependable click-through/ghost mode, multi-monitor correctness, low-latency smooth ink, vanishing-ink timing with a persistent mode, and one-keystroke export to clipboard/file. Cursor halo, spotlight/flashlight, magnifier, whiteboard/blackboard, numbered callouts, saved shortcut/color presets, and stylus pressure are valuable follow-ons after the core loop. Defer video recording/editing, cloud session sync, real-time collaboration, AI/OCR, remote clicker control, and a full screenshot editor until usage data proves demand; they expand permissions, storage, backend, or platform complexity beyond the validated annotation value.
